explanation_of_armr_mimic_iv_131: ARMR ships generated MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV vocabularies with the same 131-code ATC4 set, and its data README points to Carmen for preprocessing. The pinned ARMR commit does not include the Carmen generation run or expose one uniquely attributable frequency/mapping threshold, so the evidence supports a lineage-level reconstruction rather than an unsupported claim about one hidden subrule. The project native-173 surface is an independent MIMIC-IV v3.1 vocabulary. The benchmark difference is therefore a documented preprocessing-lineage difference, not evidence that MIMIC-IV cannot support MoleRec or ARMR.
